date_text: Thu, Sep 17th • 12:00 PM AEST - Sun, Sep 20th • 10:00 PM AEST
description: Join us this weekend at Hotel Sweeney’s Rooftop as we welcome Slow Lane Brewing for a tap takeover like no other. From Thursday midday until the kegs run dry, we’ll be pouring 12 taps of impeccable, true-to-style European beers. Expect nothing less than world-class brewing, flawless execution, and a rooftop vibe that can’t be beat. Clear your diary, round up your mates, and lock in a table. This is going to be a cracking weekend you won’t want to miss. Tap List:- - Simplicity – Helles 5% - Jagged Little Pils – German Pils 5% - Liquid Bread – Doppelbock 8.5% - Conditioned – Hazy Pale Ale 5.4% - Clean Lines – West Coast IPA 7.5% - Whiter Shade of Ale – Belgian Witbier 5% - The Red – Sparkling Ale 6% - Refectory – Belgian Blonde 4.8% - Long Shadow – Biere de Garde 7.5% - Twofold – Belgian Dubbel 7.5% - Threefold – Belgian Tripel 8.4% - Ruminator – Rum Barrel Aged Doppelbock 9.5%

date_text: Thu, Sep 24th • 12:00 PM AEST - Sun, Sep 27th • 10:00 PM AEST
description: Chuck & Son’s Brewing Co. — 12 Taps. One Rooftop. Chuck & Son’s Brewing Co. is taking over Sweeney’s Rooftop for one huge afternoon of beer, with 12 taps pouring across the rooftop. Across the taps, expect the full Chuck & Son’s range, including Two-World Pale, Old-World Lager, West Coast Heritage IPA, Alpine Hazy IPA, Traditional Hefeweizen, Touring Radler, American Amber, Amarillo XPA, Botanical IPA, Original Pilsner, Superdelic Stout and Local Lager. Come for a beer, work your way through the range, and enjoy it all overlooking Sydney from the rooftop.

date_text: Thu, Oct 1st • 12:00 PM AEST - Sun, Oct 4th • 10:00 PM AEST
description: Sunday Road Brewing Co. hits the Sweeney’s rooftop! From their award-winning Après-Ski Hefeweizen to crisp pilsners, fresh pales and even an affogato stout, the tap list is stacked. With great beers, rooftop vibes and perfect weather, it’s the best way to roll into the long weekend. Tap List: - Affogato Stout 7% - Après Ski Bavarian Hefe 5.2% - Blackwoods American Pale Ale 5.2% - Brightside Modern IPA 7.5% - Coast Track Lager 4.7% - Cryotherapy Hazy IPA 6.1% - German Pilsener 5% - Ginger beERA Ginger Beer 4% - Golden Hour Belgian Blonde 6.6% - Mexican Lager 4.5% - Mind Oasis Imperial Sour 7% - SR14° Czech Dark Lager 5.4%
